ABOUT THIS PREVIEW

About this preview

This is a website preview of Entia. The game is in development; downloads and live rankings are not connected yet.

Apocalipsis and collecting lights here are website interactions. They do not affect the game’s economy.

Walk with WASD or arrow keys, or click open ground. Walk up to a named character to open its section, or click one to cast Apocalipsis. Press C to choose a spell target, then Enter to cast. Keys 1–4 open sections.

Pause stops world animation. With reduced motion or pause enabled, each movement key press takes one step.
